title: 日志结构化解析与统计（命名分组实战）
expected_output:
=== 结构化解析 ===
10:00:01   INFO   alice  login      12 ms   msg=None
10:00:02   WARN   bob    query     350 ms   msg=None
10:00:03   ERROR  alice  update   1200 ms   msg=timeout

=== 用解析结果做统计（不写任何额外正则）===
级别分布 : {'INFO': 1, 'WARN': 1, 'ERROR': 1}
耗时 >=1000ms 的用户 : ['alice']
总耗时 = 1562 ms

=== 无法解析的行不静默丢弃 ===
解析结果 : None  <- 返回 None，调用方必须显式处理
code:
import re

LOG = [
    "2026-10-08 10:00:01 INFO  user=alice action=login  cost=12ms",
    "2026-10-08 10:00:02 WARN  user=bob   action=query  cost=350ms",
    "2026-10-08 10:00:03 ERROR user=alice action=update cost=1200ms msg=timeout",
]

PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"^(?P<date>\S+) (?P<time>\S+) (?P<level>INFO|WARN|ERROR)\s+"
    r"user=(?P<user>\w+)\s+action=(?P<action>\w+)\s+cost=(?P<cost>\d+)ms"
    r"(?:\s+msg=(?P<msg>\w+))?$"
)

print("=== 结构化解析 ===")
records = []
for line in LOG:
    m = PATTERN.match(line)
    if m is None:
        print("[跳过] 无法解析:", line)
        continue
    records.append(m.groupdict())

for r in records:
    print("%-10s %-6s %-6s %-7s %5s ms   msg=%s"
          % (r["time"], r["level"], r["user"], r["action"], r["cost"], r["msg"]))

print()
print("=== 用解析结果做统计（不写任何额外正则）===")
levels = {}
for r in records:
    levels[r["level"]] = levels.get(r["level"], 0) + 1
print("级别分布 :", levels)
slow = [r["user"] for r in records if int(r["cost"]) >= 1000]
print("耗时 >=1000ms 的用户 :", slow)
total = sum(int(r["cost"]) for r in records)
print("总耗时 = %d ms" % total)

print()
print("=== 无法解析的行不静默丢弃 ===")
bad_line = "2026-10-08 10:00:04 未知级别 x"
print("解析结果 :", PATTERN.match(bad_line), " <- 返回 None，调用方必须显式处理")
